method: Observed production API case timings and request_finished provider usage; no pricing estimate. Recall recomputed read-only from cached genuine query/person vectors and public strong-match identities; no model calls/oracle runtime injection.

storage_bytes.scope: SQLite file sizes after clean close; includes source copy, transcript/checkpoints and derived vectors. Logs/answer artifacts and prior-run archives excluded.

limits: One development/acceptance set run, not held-out accuracy, repeated-run reliability, production load, independent human review or Azure billed cost.
